name: PlusVibe
description: Cold email at scale — manage campaigns, push leads, read stats. Most calls need workspace_id.

methods.label: List Campaigns
methods.description: List campaigns in a workspace (newest first). Returns an array of campaigns. Requires workspace_id.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (required on almost every call)

methods.label: Add Leads to Campaign
methods.description: Add leads to a campaign. `leads` is an array; each lead supports email, first_name, last_name, company_name, company_website, linkedin_person_url, phone_number, custom_variables. Requires workspace_id + campaign_id. Returns the add result.

leads.description: Array of leads. Each: { email, first_name, last_name, company_name, company_website, linkedin_person_url, phone_number, custom_variables }

methods.label: List Workspace Leads
methods.description: List/search leads in a workspace. Filter by campaign_id, status, email, first_name, last_name. Returns paginated leads. Requires workspace_id.

methods.label: Campaign Stats
methods.description: Get analytics for a campaign. Requires workspace_id (and campaign_id for a single campaign). Returns sent/open/reply/bounce stats.
